implementation.factory_linkage: The complete artifact kernel closure, including nested and cold code, selects private-owner-witnessed maintained declarations. Generated launchers enable their owner-declared engine features and directly install those same declarations; they do not install the whole catalog and filter it at runtime.
implementation.fallback: Any missing, replaced or unrecognized registration evidence selects complete catalog installation. Public key/cost/function replacements, even with identical values, invalidate private evidence. Public descriptive metadata cannot recreate it.
implementation.unchanged: The Mech source, semantic graph modulo proved nominal/constant renaming, emitted native instructions modulo exact constant-slot offsets, canonical binders, grants, finite policy, one secured round, output bytes, IR20/work policy30 and every native counter are unchanged. No benchmark-specific Rust body, new resource or alternate evaluator.
implementation.limits: This removes unused linked factories but does not stream input, fuse record/normalization buffers, or achieve the footprint target.

timing.method: Twelve serial rounds per input size: all six permutations twice, so every variant occupies every position four times. One separate correctness/warmup per variant per size. Identical Node synchronous observer and regular-file descriptors opened before timing. Spawn through exit including secured report generation is timed; compilation, integrity hashing and parent validation excluded.

process_memory.method: Six serial fresh-process runs per implementation and input size; macOS /usr/bin/time -l, maximum resident set size in bytes per local getrusage(2) documentation. All six implementation-order permutations, one per round. Whole-process peak RSS, not managed-budget usage or isolated capability overhead. Separate diagnostic, no runtime timing credit.

assessment.speed: See the exact matched medians, all paired samples and ratios above. The native body is unchanged; this is a packaging change, not a claim of a substantial computational speedup.
assessment.memory: Matched125M RSS medians and ranges overlap; no meaningful RAM reduction is established by this change.

unchanged_native_counters.scope: complete original canonical artifact; shared CLI capability/provider/transaction services; argv snapshot has an aggregate acquisition cap and same-account reservation; OS/Rust argv acquisition and stdin provider cache bytes are outside the managed account

qualification.scope: Same source and graph modulo proved nominal/constant renaming; same native instructions modulo exact constant-slot offsets; same grants, finite policy, one secured round, exact output. IR20/policy30 layout and accounting are unchanged; generated launchers reference only maintained artifact-selected factory declarations. All candidate original/decoded reports match exactly. This is not a streaming or final footprint claim.

footprint_target.remaining: Whole-input capture retains254166745 bytes before line views and record/normalized buffers. General streaming of the existing authorized resource pathway, sole-use buffer fusion and further host trimming remain unfinished; speed takes priority.

limitations: Complete implementation comparison, not isolated capability overhead. CPU timing and peak-memory observations are separate serial runs on this M1.
Peak RSS and the distinct OS peak memory-footprint metric are both retained. Overlapping ranges are not evidence of a RAM improvement.
Host and libraries remain linked into one executable. Building the generated host still uses Cargo/Rust; prebuilt host distribution is not implemented.
The capability-secured host is not an OS process sandbox. PR remains draft/unmerged pending review and green CI.

evidence.availability: Raw reports, executables, logs and drivers are retained locally under tmp/pr-stack-evidence, not committed. Timing arrays, memory samples, workload/policy pins and the factory profile are included here.
